crossRefs.note: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go…
After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

translations.web: But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
translations.bsb: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
translations.kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
translations.asv: But I will come unto you, when I shall have passed through Macedonia; for I pass through Macedonia;
